_readme: Edit this file to update fares, schedules, stops, contacts and offices — the website reads it live, no code changes needed. Prices are in Kenyan Shillings (KES). See _dataNotes for two conflicts found between the two fare flyers supplied — worth double-checking before this goes live.
_dataNotes: Two source flyers gave different fares for the same three legs: Nairobi-Isiolo (KES 1,000 vs 1,500), Nairobi-Marsabit (KES 2,000 vs 3,000), Nairobi-Moyale (KES 2,500 vs 3,500). This file uses the newer 'AGREED AND APPROVED FARES' flyer's numbers (the higher ones) since it was explicitly presented as the current, partner-agreed structure. Confirm this is the right call - if the original flyer's prices are still correct, edit the relevant 'fare' values below.
Two different TikTok handles appeared across the flyers: @abyssinialuxurycoach and @abyssinia.luxury010. This file uses the former - update company.socials.tiktok if that's wrong.

The flyer promotes https://abyssinialuxurycoaches.com/ - different from the abyssinialuxurycoach.co.ke domain given at the start of this project. company.website below still points to .co.ke; change it if .com is now the real one.
